reuse.why: Each occurrence goes through the existing shared applyWeekendRule (the same function getUpcomingDates, getNextDate and the template engine use), so the move/skip decision is not re-implemented.

duplication.why: Only the RSchedule construction and try/captureBreadcrumb scaffold mirror getUpcomingDates, as is usual for handlers in this file; no rule logic is duplicated.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered in SchedulesHandlers and app.method like its siblings.

scope.why: Adds only the handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; the WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS padding is an implicit coupling to how far applyWeekendRule may move a date, which a maintainer has to remember.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend handling is delegated to applyWeekendRule from shared/schedules.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated rule logic; the handler scaffold follows the file's established pattern.
